name: Vercel
description: Frontend cloud / deployment platform with a REST API for projects, deployments, domains, DNS, env vars, teams and analytics.
access_notes: Free self-serve Hobby accounts; access tokens are created instantly on the Account Tokens page (or via API/CLI) and passed as Bearer tokens, scopable to account/team/project. Marketplace integrations use an OAuth2 code-for-token exchange (POST /v2/oauth/access_token).
mcp_notes: Official vendor remote MCP at https://mcp.vercel.com with OAuth (MCP Authorization spec, Streamable HTTP); `vercel mcp` CLI configures clients. Composio VERCEL toolkit exists with 146 tools (API_KEY auth).
uncertainty_notes: Webhooks: Vercel documents account/integration webhooks (vercel.com/docs/webhooks); not separately fetched this pass.

evidence.note: Access tokens created self-serve on the Account Tokens page (or via REST/CLI), passed as Bearer in Authorization header, scopable to account/team/project.
Integrations use OAuth: exchange short-lived code at POST https://api.vercel.com/v2/oauth/access_token with client_id/client_secret.
'Vercel MCP is Vercel's official MCP server... remote MCP with OAuth... available at https://mcp.vercel.com'; tools for docs search, project/deployment management, analytics.
REST endpoint POST /v3/user/tokens mints auth tokens programmatically; api.vercel.com REST surface.
Composio toolkit catalog lists Vercel: 146 tools, API_KEY auth.
